fusions.name: Annotated Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 arcane damage. Its damage rises 10% per affliction the target carries (max +40%).

fusions.name: Red-Pen Sweep
fusions.desc: A sweep that deals 11 arcane damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles; each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Stalled] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a struck enemy spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Corrected Draft
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spell-Edged
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
